purpose: Responsive reading adaptation of the supplied four-sheet brochure, not a pixel enhancement or a facsimile of the approved original.

mapping.sheet1: Supplied cover: product, edition, planner contact, cover artwork reused without changing the asset.
mapping.sheet2: Supplied page 2: three usage classes, injury/expense categories, four disclosure fields and excluded vehicle examples. No guarantee of eligibility is added.
mapping.sheet3: Supplied page 3 and official summary pages 1-2, 7: eligibility, payment combinations, base cover, optional covers, prerequisites, incompatible riders and definitions.
mapping.sheet4: Supplied page 4 caution topics expressed as a reading summary; official summary pages 6-9: tiered lawyer-cost 50% deductible, proportional reimbursement, surrender risk and nonparticipating nature. Illegible legal deadlines, protection amounts, approval stamp and insurer authorization are not reconstructed or invented. Original sheets remain available as source links.

display: All four sections are rendered as live text immediately. No downloads, accordions, pagination, lazy text loading or embedded raster body text. Optional single font-size toggle affects only this insurer's detail.
